name: workoutx
description: 1,900+ exercises with 720p video, a workout and program generator, supplements, and developer tools for building fitness apps.
long_description: Connects Claude to the hosted WorkoutX MCP server (https://api.workoutxapp.com/mcp): search exercises with video, find alternatives, estimate calories, generate workouts and multi-week programs, look up supplements, and use developer tools for typed models, code examples, request debugging and usage stats. Every tool call counts as one request on your WorkoutX plan. Free key (500 requests, no card): https://workoutxapp.com/dashboard.html

api_key.title: WorkoutX API key
api_key.description: Starts with wx_. Get a free key at https://workoutxapp.com/dashboard.html
